name: Diapers and diaper components
governing_basis: skin-contact extractable metals (EU REACH Annex XVII entry 72). Entry 72 excludes disposable textiles (paragraph 1(b)), so its 1 mg/kg limits bind reusable-cloth diaper components directly and are read across as the benchmark for disposable-diaper skin-contact components; the absorbent core has no metal-migration pathway
native_basis_label: extractable metal after extraction (mg/kg homogeneous material)
scope_note: Covers the diaper and its structural components: nonwoven topsheet and backsheet, the absorbent core, elastics, adhesives, and closures/fasteners. It does NOT cover baby or diaper wipes, or diaper creams, which are leave-on skin-cleansing and skin-care products certified under Category 2 (Infant and Child Personal Care), rows Baby wipes and Diaper cream.

Pb.basis: homogeneous material after extraction; source unit mg/kg
Pb.label: EU REACH entry 72 extractable-lead limit (1 mg/kg after extraction). Entry 72 excludes disposable textiles (para 1(b)); the value binds reusable-cloth components directly and is read across as the benchmark for disposable skin-contact components

tAs.basis: homogeneous material after extraction; source unit mg/kg
tAs.label: EU REACH entry 72 extractable-arsenic limit (1 mg/kg); read across per the disposable-textile exclusion

iAs.rationale: REACH textile limits regulate total arsenic; no inorganic-arsenic limit. Bounded by the tAs extraction ceiling.

Cd.basis: homogeneous material after extraction; source unit mg/kg
Cd.label: EU REACH entry 72 extractable-cadmium limit (1 mg/kg); read across per the disposable-textile exclusion

tHg.rationale: No mercury source or migration pathway in absorbent-hygiene materials (cellulose fluff, super-absorbent polymer, PE/PP nonwoven). No jurisdiction sets a diaper mercury limit.
tHg.reference_method: Screen on incoming pulp/polymer certificates of analysis.

MeHg.rationale: No methylmercury pathway in a diaper.

Ni.basis: nickel release, direct and prolonged skin contact (EN 1811)
Ni.label: Nickel release limit for direct and prolonged skin-contact articles, 0.5 µg/cm²/week (former EU Nickel Directive 94/27/EC, now REACH entry 27). A diaper is a prolonged-skin-contact article. Field evidence: Nyamukamba 2023 found extractable nickel exceeding the 0.1 mg/kg Oeko-Tex skin-contact limit in 2 of 20 diapers (0.197 sweat / 0.224 urine); retires the earlier no-metallic-component determination.

Al.rationale: No aluminium source or migration pathway in absorbent-hygiene materials.

Cr.control: No sovereign total-chromium ceiling exists for diaper materials. Total Cr remains part of the laboratory panel and is reported; the toxic species is controlled by the REACH extractable-Cr(VI) benchmark below, and any unexpected total-Cr signal triggers source investigation and speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS on the homogeneous component extraction; Cr(VI) by the applicable textile extraction method.

Cr-VI.basis: homogeneous material after extraction; source unit mg/kg
Cr-VI.label: EU REACH entry 72 extractable-Cr(VI) limit (1 mg/kg); read across per the disposable-textile exclusion

Sn.basis: organotin content as tin, skin-contact article (REACH Annex XVII entry 20; 0.1% = 1000 mg/kg). Reflex organotin speciation on a total-tin detection; ratchets toward the TDI-anchored voluntary levels (Smajgl 2015: up to 23 mg/kg total Sn, 20-100% of the organotin TDI)

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, contact-product basis; no cross-basis min)
